_comment: Ability catalog (real data drives the schema). An Ability is a named capability that lives on a Character — granted by a race, by a class, or by some other source (item, quest, scripted). Descriptions here are granter-agnostic; per-granter level gates (and any future per-granter param overrides) live on the granting record (Character Class.abilities, Race.abilities). Setting `party_effect: true` marks the Ability as a togglable party-wide effect — its id may appear in the Party.party_effects[] list and the in-game Party screen renders it as a toggle; without that flag the Ability is character/combat-only and renders on the character sheet instead. See docs/data_dictionary/ability.md.

abilities.name: Pick Locks
abilities.description: Pick locked doors and chests — d20 + DEX mod vs DC 12, one lockpick consumed per attempt.

abilities.name: Detect Traps
abilities.description: Hidden traps are revealed before the party steps on them.

abilities.name: Backstab
abilities.description: Critical hits with daggers on a successful DEX save — the humble dagger becomes a devastating weapon.

abilities.name: Shadow Step
abilities.description: Move after attacking — true hit-and-run play.

abilities.name: Turn Undead
abilities.description: Channel holy energy at every undead on the battlefield. Each one must make a Wisdom save (d20 + WIS mod vs DC 10 + caster's WIS mod) or be destroyed outright; those that succeed are still seared for 50% of their HP in radiant damage.

abilities.name: Dual Casting
abilities.description: Access to both the priest and sorcerer spell catalogs — the only class with both.

abilities.name: Herbalism
abilities.description: Nature lore spots reagents in the wild. When the party examines a tile, the holder rolls an INT save (d20 + INT mod vs DC 13) — success identifies a potion reagent. Alchemists in particular benefit from a doubled find rate.

abilities.name: Infravision
abilities.description: Pierces darkness, revealing the world in shades of red. The bearer can see in absolute darkness without needing a torch.

abilities.name: Pickpocket
abilities.description: Attempt to steal items from town NPCs. Once per NPC, with a chance of failure.

abilities.name: Galadriel's Light
abilities.description: Conjure a soft magical illumination, lighting dark areas without consuming a torch. Persists for 200 overworld steps after invocation.

abilities.name: Tinker
abilities.description: Once per in-game day, fashion any single item normally found in a general store.

abilities.name: Fast Learner
abilities.description: Requires only 1125 XP per level instead of the standard 1500, leveling up roughly 25% faster than other races.

params.note: The mechanic lives on Race.exp_per_level; this record is the character-sheet entry.

abilities.name: Nimble
abilities.description: Allows extra movement, and the ability to move after an attack

abilities.name: Brew Potion
abilities.description: Combine regents using the guidance of a recipe to create a potion
